conversation_summary.description: LLM summary of the conversation (2-3 sentences)

is_segment.description: true when this folder is one kept stretch of a longer recording

segment_count.description: how many kept stretches that recording was cut into; null when not a segment

segment_end_seconds.description: where this stretch ends on the source recording's clock, in seconds; null when not a segment

segment_index.description: 0-based position among the kept stretches of that recording; null when not a segment

segment_start_seconds.description: where this stretch starts on the source recording's clock, in seconds; null when not a segment

source_conversation_id.description: pseudonymous ID of the recording this stretch was cut from; null when not a segment

speech_dominance.description: speaker A's share of spoken words, 0..1 (0.5 = equal)

topics.description: topic tags discussed in the conversation

turn_taking_gap_ms.description: median turn-taking gap in milliseconds (conversational latency)

turns_per_minute.description: speaker handoffs per minute of complete aligned recording, excluding short overlapping backchannels
